Aramco is already rerouting.

The company is offering extra crude cargoes from Sidi Kerir, its Mediterranean port in Egypt, to bypass Bab al-Mandeb entirely.

This follows the first enforcement action under the new blockade, a drone and missile strike on 2 Saudi oil tankers.
